title: Measurement and Event Envelope v2
description: Provenance and timing envelope attached to every simulated measurement, delivered CAN frame and end-to-end event chain. All *_at_us fields are INTEGER SIMULATION MICROSECONDS on the coordinator's simulation clock. Real model inference latency lives under wall and never mixes with simulation timestamps. Stage ordering rule: when present, sampled_at_us <= computed_at_us <= received_at_us <= observed_at_us <= applied_at_us. A stage timestamp may only be missing if that stage did not happen; it must never be copied from another stage or replaced by ground truth.

kind.$comment: signal = one decoded value; can_frame = one delivered frame; event_chain = one stage of a correlated end-to-end chain (e.g. radar sample -> ADAS decision -> applied brake).

correlation_id.$comment: Links all envelopes belonging to one end-to-end chain. Present for event_chain, optional otherwise.

stage.$comment: event_chain only: acquisition | radar_compute | can_delivery | adas_decision | gateway | actuation.

validity.$comment: stale = older than its freshness budget; invalid = produced after a deadline miss, dropped frame, wrong epoch or fault. A syntactically correct number with invalid quality must never be presented as fresh ground truth.

data_age_us.$comment: observed_at_us minus sampled_at_us for this quantity. Counted once; no stage interval is double-counted.

profile_hash.$comment: Hardware/resource profile identity of the producing ECU. Frozen in the run manifest.

timestamps.description: Integer simulation microseconds. Absent stage = stage did not happen.

wall.description: Real host measurements (monotonic). Never subtracted from simulation timestamps.
